text.aria-label: Title text 'The season-year constant and the post hoc path agree on level and differ within each year'
text.tspan: The season-year constant and the post hoc path agree on level and differ

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Weekly embedded-solar capacity in MW (the 99th percentile of half-hourly AC output) behind each Primary substation. Green: season-year constant, the recommended series. Blue: post hoc asymmetric fit (a=2, r=10), offered for change within a year. Bands: 90% sampling interval. Dashed black lines: the season-year constant under two systematic scenarios. Black diamonds: experiment 00040's season-year estimate, at 1 July of the year. Kirton (grey) is range-only; read it as a range. Weeks with fewer than 3 usable days are bridged by widened intervals. Mount Bridge Boston's season-year constant falls to about 0 MW from September 2023 to August 2025, weeks that are all unobserved; do not read them.'
text.tspan: Weekly embedded-solar capacity in MW (the 99th percentile of half-hourly AC output) behind
each Primary substation. Green: season-year constant, the recommended series. Blue: post hoc
asymmetric fit (a=2, r=10), offered for change within a year. Bands: 90% sampling interval.
Dashed black lines: the season-year constant under two systematic scenarios. Black diamonds:
experiment 00040's season-year estimate, at 1 July of the year. Kirton (grey) is range-only;
read it as a range. Weeks with fewer than 3 usable days are bridged by widened intervals.
Mount Bridge Boston's season-year constant falls to about 0 MW from September 2023 to August
2025, weeks that are all unobserved; do not read them.
